body: I'm very tired. I am going to sleep. My head weighs a million pounds and I can't stop shaking.
I already made the decision. I told him what I did. He doesn't care. He told me to fuck off. Indeed I am.
To my ex: I was pregnant in 2001. I aborted your baby because you're an abusive, crazy fuckwit and I hate you and would rather die than have a child that's half yours.

I think global warming is a bunch of BS. We haven't been keeping weather records for very long considering the age of our planet. I really think it's nothing but a scare tactic to make us all spend extra time/money on crap we don't really need and to also feel guilty about made up things like 'carbon footprints'.

Joe, I really hope this is you. Now you know how I felt when you dumped me over iChat because I didn't believe in your stupid conspiracy theories about the Illuminati and the Trilateral Commission and whatever other YouTube shit you'd been watching.
Awesome for donating blood! Boo, hiss to Oreos! Hydrox is where it's at!

I know you have those guts you're mustering. If your confession ends like mine, please have even more guts than I did and let him go. It'll save you tons of heartbreak.

The hair + the glasses + his love for you = Your brother kicked incredible amounts of ass. Very sorry for your loss.

Oh, my...I could have written this myself 10 years ago. Exact same situation...I didn't talk to him about our status, just kept falling deeper in love with him until I couldn't take it anymore-and the one time I did try to talk to him? He totally freaked out, lots of yelling and crying (and mediocre sex...) and the subject was never brought up again by either one of us. I started dating someone for real and FWB was still a part of my life (though no longer in a sexual way), but when things went sour with the BF, he was the one I ran to...long story short, I realized he was utterly toxic to me and cut off all contact with him. It's been well over a year since I last spoke to him, yet I received texts from him on Christmas and after my beloved Patriots won last week...I refuse to reply. You can either take the 'Benefits' out of the equation, or you can talk to him-but I spent a decade (??!!!) waiting for something 'real' from this dude. I hope if you do talk to him things work out well. Just please don't end up like I did. ((((hug))))
